review_type: single AI curator; complete final answer personally read; identity visible; original scientific-quality rubric

errors.issue: The opening table still predicts a monotonic value increase across probabilities although its caption claims EV controlled. At fixed EV a pure value model should be flat; later fixed-magnitude versus iso-EV subdesigns partially correct this inconsistency.

p(1-p) is neither reward variance across varying magnitudes nor entropy. Reward variance includes magnitude squared; entropy has a distinct form. The iso-EV/iso-variance analysis must compute the actual variables rather than use this one interchangeable regressor.

errors.quote: on a minority of expected-reward trials **omit** reward
errors.issue: Embedding omissions and timing probes changes the experienced probability-one and fixed-time contingencies. Use separate probe blocks or explicitly model changed schedules; the certainty anchors otherwise are not certain.

errors.quote: a monotonic rise toward outcome favors value-ramp
errors.issue: Uncertainty signals can ramp toward outcome too. The answer labels this a heuristic and retains the probability comparison, so it is a quality limitation, not an automatic historical miss.
Shortening named event windows does not remove their physiological/sensor tails from the delay. Calibrate impulse responses and use wider exclusion buffers or a validated observation model.

errors.quote: exclude that session from primary analysis
errors.issue: Task-response failure is not automatically technical failure. Session-level RPE gating can select the population and should be reported with independent technical/behavioral criteria and all-session sensitivity.

errors.quote: this indicates the apparent uncertainty effect was an EV artifact
errors.issue: Loss in iso-EV conditions can reflect changed magnitude, learning, power or a different uncertainty metric; it does not uniquely prove a value artifact.

These measure different quantities with different dynamics. Select and implement a model/region/platform, calibrated sensor timing if used, concrete iso-EV distributions and behavior/surgical/welfare workflow; many central choices remain deferred.

rationale: Core probability grid, independent identification prerequisite, value/uncertainty comparison and temporally separated intermediate maximum are present, so historical direction qualifies. Major metric, scheduling and temporal-interpretation errors reduce original scientific quality. Session-level assay checks are distinguished from explicit per-neuron response-based exclusion; ramping is not itself disqualifying.
reference_guardrails: All three complete final answers personally read against full question/reference/target; truncated Grok tail and Qwen middle sections separately read. Original rubric only; strict round inactive.

Historical qualification follows explicit reference core: uncertainty versus value, probability manipulation, separated phasic/delay readouts, intermediate-versus-endpoint prediction. Matched-value/magnitude challenges improve scientific identification; their incomplete implementation limits quality without silently becoming an extra binary gate.

Ramping or late pre-outcome activity can be an uncertainty correlate. Its timing alone cannot select hazard. Assess joint probability-by-time models and timing controls; never reject the historical direction solely because its signal grows near outcome.

Physiological dopamine identity is putative unless independently validated; selecting cells for event responses biases the sampled population. A preparation-level assay check is distinct from per-neuron response selection.

Fixed-magnitude inverted-U activity distinguishes certain prespecified linear/value models, not every nonlinear value, salience, temporal or movement model. Correlated covariate adjustment and held-out decoding do not alone identify cause.

Probability probes and run-limited schedules alter experienced contingencies. Preserve actual conditional probabilities, history and all valid anticipatory trials; future-outcome splits are diagnostics, not grounds for outcome-based neural selection.

The primary paper itself documents incomplete intermediate-probability coverage in a subset of cells. This is a limitation to disclose, not proof of fabrication or a reason to copy the sampling bias. Reference guardrails remain modern proposed controls, not claims that the historical study implemented them.

Source depth: primary PDF abstract, experiment description, Results and figure captions through Fig. 3 personally read. Supporting Methods not audited. Do not certify the paper or reconstruct missing procedures from those excerpts.
